competitorWins: Crisis24 is genuinely stronger for enterprise duty of care and crisis response: intelligence coverage across 200+ countries and 800+ provinces, analyst-verified reporting, traveler tracking, mass-notification capabilities, and owned medical/security response and evacuation operations as part of GardaWorld. Organizations with travelers, assets, and people in harm's way buy Crisis24 for a complete risk-management suite — a different market from WorldEye's freemium consumer platform.
description: Crisis24 (part of GardaWorld) is an enterprise risk-intelligence and critical-event-management platform covering 200+ countries, with deep country and city risk assessments, real-time incident intelligence, mass notifications, traveler tracking, and API integrations. It differs from WorldEye by being a quote-based enterprise suite for corporate security, travel risk, and crisis response — no public free tier — while WorldEye is a free, no-signup live-planet globe with cameras, flights, ships, and weather, plus Pro OSINT extras for individuals at a fraction of an enterprise seat price.

verdictCompetitor: Choose Crisis24 if your organization needs analyst-verified risk intelligence, traveler tracking, mass notifications, and real medical/security response operations.
verdictWorldEye: Choose WorldEye if you want free, no-signup live global awareness — cameras, flights, ships, weather, quakes — plus Pro OSINT tools from $3.99/week, without an enterprise contract.
whyWorldEye: WorldEye's map is free with no signup; Crisis24 sells custom enterprise subscriptions with no free tier.
One free globe combines ~76,000 live cameras with live flights, ships, satellites, weather, earthquakes, and wildfires — a live picture Crisis24 doesn't offer.
Pro costs $3.99/week (vs. enterprise contracts): AI analyst assistant, OSINT recon toolkit (Nmap, DNS, WHOIS, SSL), premium cyber/GDELT/maritime/conflict intel feeds, and high-res satellite imagery.
Free live aircraft and maritime tracking that Crisis24 doesn't publish as consumer features.
Interactive 3D globe with global search and advanced filters, built for anyone — not just security operations centers.
For individuals and small teams, WorldEye is the affordable complement to enterprise platforms like Crisis24.
